source: Smithers modules that the platform split refused because the moved code read an exported primitive const: flows/platform-node NodeLanguageServer.ts (MAX_QUEUED_FRAMES), ProcessReaper.ts (defaultPsExecutable, then posixSystem calls the wrapper at load), build/targets JevLint.ts (maximumJudgedFileBytes = 256 * 1024) and build-cli AgentSession.ts (an object literal above the const holds a deferred call). Minimized; names and shapes kept.

modules.text:
import { createHash } from "node:crypto"

/** The most frames a client queues before it drops the oldest. */
export const MAX_QUEUED_FRAMES = 64

export const frameKey = (frame: string): string =>
  createHash("sha256").update(frame).digest("hex").slice(0, MAX_QUEUED_FRAMES)

export const queueLimit = (): number => MAX_QUEUED_FRAMES
